games.description: Sark and NFEN try a Doors-style co-op maze. They open rooms, rummage through drawers for keys, and deal with an entity before leaving the unfinished hundred-room route.
games.title: Backdoors

games.description: A co-op RPG and shooter trial with NFEN. After connection trouble, Sark explores the poolrooms outpost, follows scientist quests and slides, gathers loot and weapons, and leaves the boss route unfinished.
games.title: Backrooms Cycle

games.description: A solo key-and-code escape attempt. Sark uses debug movement to explore the maze, reaches the pools, and abandons the run after failing to find the next trigger.
games.title: Backrooms Doors

games.description: A short multiplayer trial with NFEN. Sark takes turns being the monster in Survival, then tests the timed generator switches in Run and Escape.
games.title: BackRooms New

games.description: Sark and NFEN try scavenging expeditions from a shared hub. They document entities and radiation, sell resources, buy gear and passes, and investigate contracts and crafting. A later brief visit returns to the game.
games.title: Backrooms Society

games.description: A solo run through the low-budget Backrooms, managing sanity and surviving chases before searching the later building for access cards and fixing the camera feeds. The early-access finish unlocks a brief Meme Rooms trial.
games.title: Budget Backrooms

games.description: A solo trial as a captive explorer, sent into the Backrooms to earn money for his son’s release. Hub instructions, loot collection and lockpicking are hampered by awkward interfaces; the visit ends without securing freedom.
games.title: C.I.E.B The Backrooms Project

games.description: A solo attempt through a broken Backrooms maze. Sark tests the available debug controls, searches for the route, collects the remaining objects, and leaves after repeated problems with audio, enemies and collision.
games.title: Exit the Backrooms

games.description: Sark and NFEN work through a short co-op Backrooms game, using clocks and room clues before a dark section causes repeated deaths. They return briefly to inspect the additional mode and its candle-lit maze.
games.title: Return the Backrooms

games.description: Sark and NFEN revisit a familiar camera-and-key hunt together, recognize the recycled rooms and finish their short multiplayer trial.
games.title: The Backrooms Multiplayer

games.description: Sark explores a multi-floor building, hunts breaker switches and reaches an elevator that refuses to let him out.
games.title: The Backrooms Recorded

games.description: Sark and NFEN use chem lights to search for keys, dodge the noisy backrooms creature and move through the small set of levels.
games.title: UnderBackrooms
